item.text: {"search_note":"Search gap: I did not find any reliable 2024 source showing Khamenei empowering audit bodies, local governments, or genuinely independent courts or legislatures against his own preferences. The available 2024 material points the other way, toward continued subordination and tighter control.","evidence":[{"title":"Iran bans ex-president Rouhani from running for elite assembly","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-01-24","url":"https://theprint.in/world/iran-bans-ex-president-rouhani-from-running-for-elite-assembly/1937211/","summary":"The Guardian Council barred Hassan Rouhani from the Assembly of Experts, which can supervise and dismiss the supreme leader.
